title: explicit "version":99 (above current) is refused as unsupported-version
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: `{"version":99,` spliced in right after the opening brace, before `"contractId"`. pinned-because-current ([WIR1-C16]): emitted frames carry no version key (`WireFrame.version` defaults to `WireCodec.VERSION` with `encodeDefaults` unset — `WireCodecTest."KE3-39 - VERSION is omitted from every encoded frame…"`), so this guard is reachable only by a foreign frame; the check is strict equality, not a floor or range (this vector and WV-NEG-VERSION-BELOW-01 together pin that — B2.6/B2.7). Cite computenet-u5gb and doc/spec/40-distribution/42-replication.md §"Decision: the frame version stays unemitted, and the check stays a foreign-frame guard". Observed IllegalStateException "unsupported wire version 99". Dead-letter accounting on the receiving side is covered by wire/src/test/kotlin/civictech/wire/WsIngressDecodeFailureTest.kt, not retested here.
